findings.description: List 'primary' (https://engineering.jhu.edu/ece/faculty/): 44 entries enumerated from the shared browser capture; capture file SHA-256 recomputed and matches shared-sources capture_sha256. No pager, load-more or filter was used on this page per the capture metadata.

List 'secondary' (https://engineering.jhu.edu/ece/people/ece-affiliates/): 21 entries enumerated from the shared browser capture; capture file SHA-256 recomputed and matches shared-sources capture_sha256. No pager, load-more or filter was used on this page per the capture metadata.

List 'research-staff' (https://engineering.jhu.edu/ece/research/research-staff/): 10 entries enumerated from the shared browser capture; capture file SHA-256 recomputed and matches shared-sources capture_sha256. No pager, load-more or filter was used on this page per the capture metadata.

List 'emeriti' (https://engineering.jhu.edu/ece/people/professor-emeriti/): 5 entries enumerated from the shared browser capture; capture file SHA-256 recomputed and matches shared-sources capture_sha256. No pager, load-more or filter was used on this page per the capture metadata.

Enumeration: 44 primary + 21 secondary + 10 research-staff + 5 emeriti = 80 entries, 79 distinct people. James West appears on both the primary and emeriti lists and is counted once (emeritus). Every brief person appears on a capture and every capture name is in the brief; no omissions.
Profile pages were not fetched: for this school only the shared browser captures are cited as evidence (profile pages are blocked). Decisions rest on the list titles and department lines.
Captured primary-list entry has no per-person profile URL; the brief's directory entry id is used. Decision rests on the primary-list title 'Assistant Teaching Professor' and department line.

Decision: excluded, membership outside_ece. The primary-list entry (title 'Bessie Darling Massey Professor and Director') captures only the line 'DEPARTMENT OF BIOMEDICAL ENGINEERING' with no ECE department line, so he is not an ECE faculty member of this roster per the shared-evidence note. Category 'academic_professional' is the closest excluded category available; the policy has no outside-unit category. This would change only if an ECE department line or ECE professorial appointment were shown on the ECE roster.
Decision: excluded as emeritus (past). He is on the primary list ('Professor Emeritus') and on the professor-emeriti list ('Professor Emeritus'); one person.
